reviews.text: Действительно помогает. Уже после второго раза старые пигментные пятна немного посветлели.
reviews.zh: 真係有幫助。第二次之後，舊嘅色素斑已經稍微變淺咗。

reviews.text: Not sure that 9 patches are going to do much to this one dark spot I have in my cheek area but I am about 1/2 through and have not seen a difference. I think I need a dermatologist or a peel to really see a difference. The dark spot is a lot darker than the rest of my skin so I made need professional help.
reviews.zh: 我唔肯定 9 塊貼會唔會對我面頰上呢個黑斑有太大作用，我而家用咗大約一半，但未見到有分別。我諗我需要睇皮膚科醫生或者去做換膚先至睇到明顯效果。個黑斑比我其他皮膚深好多，所以我可能需要專業協助。

reviews.text: This is excellent for healing popped pimples, aiding their recovery, and speeding up the deformation of scabs and skin, which helps minimise marks.
reviews.zh: 呢款非常適合用嚟修復爆咗嘅痘痘，幫助佢哋康復，同埋加快結痂同皮膚嘅變化，有助減少痕跡。

reviews.text:
Se sienten las agujas actuando en la piel.

Bajó una mancha que tengo en el rostro, pero siento que hay que usarlo día y noche para cumplir con el efecto deseado-
reviews.zh:
可以感覺到細針喺皮膚上作用。

佢令我面上嘅一個斑淡咗少少，但我覺得要日夜都用，先至達到想要嘅效果。

reviews.text: One of the best pimple stickers, it really work if you put a pimple cream and let it dry then put the Patch on top, it. It will go in no time
reviews.zh: 係最好嘅痘痘貼之一，如果你先塗痘痘膏，等佢乾咗之後再將貼放上面，真係好有效。好快就會消退。

reviews.text: It used to work well but did not see much of a difference this time. However it’s better than not using it.
reviews.zh: 以前用得好好，不過今次冇見到太大分別。但係總比唔用好。

reviews.text: Seems like darkspots clear up after using these at night, they work great
reviews.zh: 好似晚上用咗之後色斑淡咗，效果幾好。

reviews.text: I like that it has vit c and little needles but i have not noticed a surprising brightening effect.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢含有維他命 C 同細針，但係我未見到令人驚喜嘅提亮效果。
